# ucode module
> ucode scripting language: standard library, runtime modules (fs, ubus, uci, uloop, nl80211, rtnl), and C API.
> **Total Context:** ~89833 tokens

- [bundled-reference.md](./bundled-reference.md): Complete monolithic reference for ucode when a larger context window is available. (~90041 tokens, l4-monolith)

## Tooling Surfaces
